$t20DriverTokens=$null;$t20DriverErrors=$null

$t20Utf8=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$t20BomUtf8=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($true)
$t20Sha=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
try{
$t20DriverSha=([BitConverter]::ToString($t20Sha.ComputeHash($t20Utf8.GetBytes($t20Driver)))).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant()
[byte[]]$t20BomBytes=$t20BomUtf8.GetPreamble()+$t20BomUtf8.GetBytes($t20Driver)

}finally{$t20Sha.Dispose()}
$t20Validation=& $t20GuidedPath -ValidateOnly
[ordered]@{
schema_version=1;shell=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();edition=$PSVersionTable.PSEdition
windows_version=[Environment]::OSVersion.Version.ToString()

}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
if(@($t20Errors).Count -ne 0 -or @($t20DriverErrors).Count -ne 0 -or $t20Validation.status -ne 'validated'){exit 1}
exit 0

A49 requires actual guided results and named tester confirmation. No acceptance pass is inferred from ValidateOnly.

The read-only validator created no files. After both snapshots, its outer collector wrote the evidence report; a later provenance controller reserved a separate marked TEMP tree, retained exact validated guided and original-record bytes, and appended snapshot provenance without changing raw invocations.
Future Git checkout line-ending normalization must be independently proved against the retained exact validated snapshot; no future-byte validation is claimed here.
